evals.prompt: I need a TikTok video about cleaning a pair of disgusting old sneakers until they look brand new. The first second has to stop people from scrolling. Make it 30 seconds.
evals.expected_output: A production-grade Seedance 2.0 on Higgsfield prompt, roughly 15-25 lines, built around a scroll-stopping first-2-seconds hook for a 30-second 9:16 vertical TikTok. It opens with a macro/extreme close-up shock of the grimy shoe, includes a frame-by-frame hook timeline (0.0-0.3s, 0.3-0.8s, etc.), on-screen text overlays, ASMR/sound cues, and a full-video continuation plus caption and hashtag suggestions.
expectations: Output is a Seedance 2.0 on Higgsfield prompt explicitly engineered around the first 2 seconds as a scroll-stopping hook.
Output includes a sub-second hook timeline with timestamps (e.g. 0.0-0.3s, 0.3-0.8s, 1.5-2.0s) describing cuts and on-screen text.
Output specifies 9:16 vertical format and TikTok-oriented sound/audio plus caption and hashtag strategy.
Output is approximately 15-25 lines and targets a 30-second short-form video rather than a long-form or cinematic film.
